date_text: Thu, Jul 2nd • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jul 5th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: This Thursday, Hotel Sweeney’s is taken over by one of Australia’s best breweries! We’re pouring a monster 20-tap takeover from BentSpoke Brewing Co. from Canberra. Richard and Tracy have built a reputation for producing consistently outstanding beers, and with 20 different brews on tap, this is the perfect chance to explore everything from fresh favourites to limited releases. If you love great craft beer, you won’t want to miss this one. Tap List:- - Crankshaft IPA 5.8% - Barley Griffen Pale Ale 4.2% - Hazee Hazy Pale Ale 4.4% - Sprocket IPA 7% - Red Nut Red IPA 7% - Shifters Lager 4.4% - Half Cranked Session IPA 3.2% - Zappa Cherry Saison 9% - Switchback XPA 4.8% - Descent Imperial Stout 10% - Frenzy Raspberry Wheat Beer 5% - Folk Stout Irish Dry Stout 5% - Yakima Charge West Coast IPA 6.8% - Night Shifter Dark Lager 4.4% - Cluster 8 IIPA 8.8% - Cluster 10 IIIPA 10% - Big Nut Black IPA 7% - Dick Tracy Brown Ale 5.8% - Berry Sour - Grainy Nitro Stout 7%
